existing_bounded_contexts.note: These are the contexts that exist today. Design contracts should bind to them or state explicitly why a new context is required. Inventing a parallel structure is how a design becomes unimplementable against the codebase it governs.

architecture_fitness_today.note: Fitness already runs in CI with a deliberate-violation test proving each check can fail. deterministic_enforcement_opportunities should prefer extending this suite over proposing new machinery -- Phase 3 promoted 7 gates into existing layers and proposed zero new ones.

gap_trap_promotions_to_honour.note: 7 promotions exist with named enforcement layers, deterministic rules and proven-red methods. A design contract covering the same semantics should reference the promotion rather than invent a second control.
